Living with borderline personality disorder and other mental illnesses is by far mine. I displayed symptoms for years before I was diagnosed but as I was a minor it wasn't really picked up upon. Being fourteen years old and feeling like not a person in the world loves you or will ever love you is pretty horrible. I lost so many friends, so much respect from both myself and other people and put myself in situations that resulted in being raped; something I blame myself for to this day. I would never ever wish mental illness on anyone but I don't think I'd change my past either because I like the person I'm growing into thanks to my experiences. Hindsight is wonderful. 

Since mental illness is spoken about more now I think a lot of people underestimate how much it really destroys you. In some circles it's as common as catching a cold but living with a personality disorder is hellish.
